B0DR7FCLZR.title: PETME2 Stainless Steel Cat Water Fountain 108oz/3.2L, Dog Water Fountain for Cats & Dogs Indoor, LED Light, Quiet Pump, Faucet & Bubbling Dual Flow Modes, 4-Layer Filter, Dishwasher Safe
bullets: TWO FLOW MODES FOR PICKY DRINKERS: Switch between a running faucet stream and a gentle bubbling flow to match how your pet likes to drink. Moving, circulating water invites cats and dogs to drink more often than a still bowl, so this pet fountain suits every drinking style in the house.

STAINLESS STEEL, NOT PLASTIC: The fountain base is made of rust-resistant, BPA-free stainless steel that is hygienic and easy to wipe clean. This metal cat fountain gives pets a durable drinking surface instead of a plastic bowl, with a sleek silver look that fits any kitchen or living room.

4-LAYER FILTER PLUS SPONGE: Cotton mesh, activated carbon, ion-exchange resin and a fine filter pad, backed by a high-density sponge, trap hair and debris and reduce odors for fresher water. A filter cartridge is included; replace it every 2 to 3 weeks for best results.

QUIET PUMP AND LED LIGHT: A low-voltage DC 5V pump runs quietly day and night, powered by the included AC adapter and USB cable. The LED light makes the water level easy to check in a dark room, and you can turn it off with the switch on the cable when you prefer a dark space.

108OZ CAPACITY, EASY TO CLEAN: The 3.2L reservoir holds plenty of fresh water for multi-pet homes, so you refill less often. A 360-degree raised rim helps stop splashes and keeps floors dry, and the detachable parts are dishwasher safe for a fast, simple clean of this automatic water dispenser.
B0DR7FCLZR.description: Give your cats and dogs fresh, moving water all day with the PETME2 Stainless Steel Cat Water Fountain. It holds 108oz (3.2L), enough for busy households with more than one pet, and doubles as a pet water fountain for dogs. Choose between two flow modes: a running faucet stream for pets that like to drink from the tap, or a gentle bubbling flow for pets that prefer a calm surface. Flowing water attracts pets and encourages them to drink more often than a still bowl. The stainless steel base is rust-resistant, BPA-free and easy to wipe clean, giving you a cat water dispenser with a modern silver look that fits any room. Inside, a 4-layer filter (cotton mesh, activated carbon, ion-exchange resin and a fine pad) plus a high-density sponge catches hair and debris and reduces odors. Replace the filter every 2 to 3 weeks for best results. The low-voltage DC 5V pump runs quietly, powered by the included AC adapter and USB cable. An LED light lets you see the water level at night, and a switch on the cable turns it off. A 360-degree raised rim helps keep floors dry, and the detachable parts are dishwasher safe. In the box: stainless steel fountain base, pump, 4-layer filter cartridge with sponge, LED light module, power adapter, USB cable and instruction manual.
